class_imbalance.finding: Significant class imbalance exists naturally in the collected corpus. Highly destructive economic plagues (Citrus Greening, Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl) were heavily sampled, while healthy leaf controls for minor crops like Potato and Raspberry have lower sample representations.

real_world_generalization.details: PlantVillage leaves were shot under controlled indoor conditions against uniform neutral backgrounds. Models trained strictly on PlantVillage may experience performance degradation when confronted with messy field backgrounds (soil, weeds, shadows, wet leaf reflections). The project addresses this via multimodal symptom fusion.

data_leakage.details: In original PlantVillage capture sessions, multiple photographs of a single infected leaf were recorded from varying angles. A pure random split can allocate different views of the exact same leaf to both training and test sets.
